extracted.intended_audience: Applicants and peer reviewers for UKRI STFC research grant opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Assessment guidance and criteria used to evaluate STFC/UKRI research grant proposals, including high-level UKRI criteria and specific considerations for sustainability and associated doctoral studentships.

rubrics_metrics.name: vision
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as one of the high level UKRI criteria that will form the basis of assessment for most research grant opportunities. Further detail and how questions map to assessment is available in the 'core section questions and how they will be assessed' guidance referenced on the funding finder entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: approach
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as one of the high level UKRI criteria forming the basis of assessment. Applicants should provide evidence in the proposal to justify the approach. Opportunity-specific guidance in the funding finder may expand on expectations (methods, feasibility, risk mitigation, timelines).

rubrics_metrics.name: applicant and team capability to deliver
rubrics_metrics.description: applicant and team capability to deliver
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether the named applicants and team have the skills, track record and capacity to deliver the proposed work. Peer review is based on evidence provided in the proposal (e.g., track record, roles, management plans).

rubrics_metrics.name: resources and cost justification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment of whether requested resources are appropriate and justified for the proposed work. Funding finder/opportunity guidance may provide further detail on eligible costs and expectations for cost justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: ethics and responsible research innovation (RRI)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation of ethical considerations and responsible research and innovation practices in the proposal. Applicants should include relevant ethical approvals, plans for RRI, and mitigation of potential harms as evidence for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: opportunity-specific additional criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Some opportunities may also require additional criteria and, where this is the case, the funding finder entry will make this clear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers and applicants must consult the specific funding finder entry for any extra criteria (for example, criteria specific to commercialisation or public engagement). Do not assume the high-level UKRI criteria are exhaustive for all calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: peer review evidence requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are reminded that peer review is based on evidence provided in a proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers will base judgements only on the information supplied in the application; applicants should ensure claims are supported by appropriate evidence (track record, preliminary data, detailed plans).

rubrics_metrics.name: sustainability (of key instrument or construction groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainability (of key instrument or construction groups)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In consolidated grant applications, panels may consider the health and critical mass in key instrument or construction groups and how this is maintained. The sustainability of key instruments or construction groups may therefore be assessed. More details on sustainability criteria are provided in funding opportunity guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: doctoral studentship not on critical path
rubrics_metrics.description: The doctoral studentship must not be on the critical path for delivery of the grant objectives
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If funding is sought for a doctoral studentship alongside a grant, the studentship should not be essential to achieving the grant's core deliverables. Applicants should demonstrate that the grant objectives can be met without the studentship being critical.

rubrics_metrics.name: doctoral studentship is a discrete project suitable for training
rubrics_metrics.description: The doctoral studentship should be a discrete project suitable for training a doctoral student
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The studentship must constitute a coherent, standalone research project appropriate for a PhD-level training experience. It should have clearly defined research questions, methods and milestones appropriate for doctoral training.

rubrics_metrics.name: departmental accreditation for STFC doctoral students
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed department must be accredited to award STFC doctoral students
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only departments accredited by STFC to award doctoral students may host the studentship. Applicants should confirm and evidence departmental accreditation in the proposal or follow the funding opportunity guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: doctoral project quality and appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration should be given to the quality and appropriateness of the doctoral project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers will assess whether the doctoral project is intellectually substantive, well-scoped for a PhD, and aligned with training aims. Evidence and rationale should be provided in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: doctoral training in research methods and techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration should be given to whether the project provides a sound training in research method and techniques
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The studentship should demonstrate opportunities for robust methodological training and hands-on experience appropriate to the discipline. Applicants should describe planned supervision, training activities and technical skill acquisition.

rubrics_metrics.name: broader skills training availability for the student
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration should be given to the broader skills training available to the student
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment includes whether the student will receive transferable skills, professional development and broader training (e.g., communication, project management, ethics). Describe departmental/centre-wide training provision and bespoke development plans.
